# IERC4626MultiTokenWrapper
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/extensions/ERC4626MultiTokenWrapper/IERC4626MultiTokenWrapper.sol)

**Inherits:**
[IERC4626MultiToken](../ERC4626MultiToken/ierc4626-multi-token.md)

**Title:**
IERC4626MultiTokenWrapper

**Author:**
Roberto Cano <robercano>

Variant of ERC-4626 that mints ERC-1155 receipts instead of a fungible share token. The
id chosen by the implementation (typically a round number) is the natural key for
attaching extra per-deposit state — e.g. a per-round exchange rate when capital is moved
into the wrapped target vault on a settlement tick.

`withdraw`, `previewWithdraw`, and `maxWithdraw` from ERC-4626 are intentionally omitted —
implementing them would require enumerating ERC-1155 ids per account, which is prohibitively
expensive in gas. Users redeem by id via `redeem` / `redeemBatch` instead.


## Functions
### vault

Returns the address of the target ERC-4626 vault this wrapper batches deposits for.


```solidity
function vault() external view returns (address vaultAddress);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`vaultAddress`|`address`|The address of the wrapped target vault|
